issues.location: exercise comparing possible ranks of Cartesian products
issues.finding: The second displayed product-rank expression has no relation sign between setrank(A times B) and max(setrank(A),setrank(B)) plus two, making the exercise mathematically incomplete.
issues.proposed_resolution: Insert equality in the second requested example; the first requested example already uses equality and the preceding bound permits the upper-end equality.

issues.location: proof of the Cartesian-product rank bound
issues.finding: After bounding A times B by the double power set of A union B, the proof cites the ordered-pair rank formula. Computing the rank of that double power set instead requires the power-set rank formula twice and the union rank formula.
issues.proposed_resolution: Replace the irrelevant ordered-pair citation with references to the power-set rank formula twice and the binary union rank formula.
